Retained-WAL states tested: -shm present (R2 and fault tests) and -shm removed (control, compatible geometry). A WAL that the read-only connection cannot open but a writable open could recover, for example with a read-only -shm, is untested and is now refused.

Non-geometry refusals still run after the writable open and may checkpoint a retained WAL. No byte-identity claim is made for them (unchanged from R2).
Refusal with -shm absent and the latency of the extra read-only connection are not tested or measured.
